text:
maya: Quick alertnoticed a persistent p99 hit on batchers after the "prefetch-size" tweak. Small requests look affected. Anyone digging in?

samir: yup. p99 +40ms for token<=16. repro on batchers-us-west.

jin: I rolled the change (prefetch=6 -> global) yesterday to improve medium batch fill.

maya: logs show small requests blocking on a join that waits for a prefetched slot. snippet:
```
enqueue id=tx42 size=10 prefetch=6 wait_for_join=23ms held_by=req_big_17k
```

elena: that pattern matches longer coalescing windows. prefetch increases chance a large request enters the window and stalls small ones.

ryan: are we seeing KV cache cold misses too? high prefetch could evict hot entries and cause warmup spikes.

samir: good call. I see a correlation between eviction_count and p99 shortly after the rollout.

maya: options: 1) roll back prefetch on short-request shard, 2) per-route soft_reserve so tiny routes bypass deep prefetch, 3) microfast lane for requests under X tokens, 4) deadline-aware admission using route.deadline_hint.

jin: microfast lane adds code surface but would be deterministic: tiny queue with T=3ms and capacity N. small requests never get behind big ones.

elena: soft_reserve is cheaper: admission grants a small reservation token for tiny routes that allows them to cut ahead of prefetched joins. simpler to wire.

samir: I'm leaning rollback + observability first. we need histograms: join_wait_by_size, hold_reason.label, prefetched_vs_direct_join. can we instrument quickly?

elena: I can add those metrics and labels (tenant, size_bucket, hold_reason) in a PR today.

ryan: also consider making prefetch window adaptive: controller shrinks window when tail breaches SLO, expands when stable. simple PID-ish controller based on p99 slope.

jin: prototype controller could run in admission-controller and tune local prefetch per-shard. cheap to test.

deploy-bot: deploy: prefetch-change applied to cluster/batchers-main at 03:12 UTC by jin.

maya: okay let's do immediate mitigation: roll prefetch back to 3 on the tiny-request shard and enable extra telemetry. who will take?

samir: I'll perform the rollback and post the change.

elena: metrics PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/metrics/pull/204 (WIP) 

jin: I'll start a quick prototype for adaptive prefetch; aim for a canary next week.

ryan: follow-ups: - evaluate eviction_rate x prefetch interaction - perf test microfast lane in sim harness - plan per-route soft_reserve API (config + enforcement)

maya: timeline: rollback now, metrics in 48h, prototype in 7d, subsequent decision on microfast vs soft_reserve after data.

metric-bot: alert: after rollback p99 returned to baseline within 10 minutes (checked against baseline window).

maya: thanks team. please add notes to the RFC thread with results so we can pick a long-term approach. :thumbsup:
